environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on EC2 with Redis cache backend (CACHE_DRIVER=redis). The application database user 'app_user' has full CRUD privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the app_settings table. The /config GET endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication. Redis is shared across all application instances with no key namespace isolation. No rate limiting or input validation middleware on tenant header.

config.db_privileges: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON app_db.*
